body:
On the Roadmap tab, show milestones by `targetDate`, earliest first. Milestones with no date come after them, ordered by rank and then id. "No milestone" stays last.

- Remove the milestone **Up** and **Down** buttons. Nothing on this page sends a milestone `rank` any more.
- Update the Roadmap tab section of the strategy README (Groups, Reorder) and the tests.

Left out: the Features tab keeps grouping in rank order, and the milestone `rank` field stays on the server.
title: roadmap: milestones sorted by due date
